description: This file defines API routes for managing student applications in a FastAPI web service. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, submitting, and withdrawing applications, along with health check. The code relies on SQLAlchemy models and schemas for data handling.

methods.name: ApplicationPublic _to_public(app: Application)
methods.description: Converts an Application ORM object to its public schema representation.

methods.name: list[ApplicationPublic] list_my_applications( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Lists all applications owned by the authenticated student.

methods.name: ApplicationPublic create_application( payload: ApplicationCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Creates a new draft application for the authenticated student.

methods.name: ApplicationPublic get_my_application( application_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific application by ID if owned by the authenticated student.

methods.name: ApplicationPublic update_application( application_id: str, payload: ApplicationUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Allows students to update their application details when in draft or needs_info status.

methods.name: SubmitApplicationResponse submit_application( application_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Submits an application, changing its status and logging the transition along with notification.

methods.name: ApplicationPublic withdraw_application( application_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles({"student"})), )
methods.description: Allows a student to withdraw a pending application.

methods.name: dict auth_health(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Health check endpoint for authenticated users.
